title: Concept Influence: Leveraging Interpretability to Improve Performance and Efficiency in Training Data Attribution

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to politically sensitive survey questions (e.g., the 'Misaligned Opinions' dataset) using an LLM judge to score the presence of strong biases, fabricated statistics, and conspiracy theories under an 'evil' persona trait.

Finetuning models on datasets designed to induce emergent misalignment and utilizing an OpenAI API-based LLM judge to evaluate a 'sycophancy' trait score (ranging from 0-100) based on the model's outputs.
